question:
Seven boxes U, V, W, X, P, Q and R are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. 

Only three boxes are kept below V. Only two boxes are kept between V and U. Only P is kept above X. R is kept at some place below Q and at some place above W. Which box is kept at the second position from the bottom?
solution:
**Given,**

Only three boxes are kept below V.

Only two boxes are kept between V and U.

Only P is kept above X.

R is kept at some place below Q and at some place above W.
